sentences.text:
The applicant has filed this First bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail, who has been in judicial custody since 22.03.2023 in connection with Crime No.197/2023 registered at Police Station- Ranjhi, District- Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376 and 376 (2)(N) and 109 of I.P.C.
2.
It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that he is suffering confinement since 22.03.2023.
As per allegations, applicant forced himself over prosecutrix but from the contents of statement U/s.164 Cr.P.C., allegations are omnibus in nature and are very casual.
She nowhere refers any specific particulars so as to conclude about the alleged conduct of applicant qua prosecutrix.
Even otherwise, apparently prime accused appears to be Lucky Srivas rather than the present applicant.
Applicant does not bear any criminal record.
Confinement amounts to pre-trial detention.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial and would make himself available as and when Sunnel Kori vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023

1 required.
He would not be a source of embarrassment or harassment in any manner to the complainant side.
Under these grounds, he prayed for bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for its dismissal.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.
Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and the period of custody but without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant :-
1.

The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;
2. The applicant will cooperate in the investigation/trial, as the case may be;
6. Application stands allowed and disposed of.
7. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
Certified copy as per rules.
